why: 'maba5las4 el marateb' wrong verb and gender; Egyptians say 'ma sarafetsh el marateb'.
'el z7ma di 3aleeha 7ekma' is nonsensical; no Egyptian would type this.
'7ekma el yom' is an English calque ('wisdom of the day'), unnatural in chat.
'el 7ekma me7taga' calque; MSA 'enna'; natural is 'el mawdo3 me7tag 7ekma'.
'3ashan a2al el zahma' uses a2al as a verb; unnatural, Egyptians say 'asba2 el zahma'.
'hatwassel awi w t3adi 3ala el masaa3' is garbled, not Egyptian phrasing.
'te2a3ed' is a wrong verb form (to23od); clause linkage is clumsy.
Pronoun clash: 'a2ol lek' (you) then 'ma2oltelhash' (her).
'el zehma za7ma' redundant; bare 'ana a2ol' needs 'ba2ol'; 'yefta' unclear.
'bokra a2ol le nafsi' lacks future ha-; Egyptians say 'ha2ol'.
Ending 'bara snehm' is gibberish.
'abos el talifon' and 'awageh a3da2 el shoghl' are unnatural, garbled phrasing.
Calling the opposing team 'el a3da2' is unnatural; Egyptians say 'el fari2 el tany'.
'el soora awda7' is a calque and a non-sequitur inside an apology.
'el 7al yeb2a awda7' is not an Egyptian collocation; 'nerteb' misform of nrattab.
Illogical: wake early so things are clearer before I sleep; unnatural phrasing.
'akher haga te5aly el wa7ed yetganen' is a calque; natural is '7aga tgannen'.
'3enni' misspells 'enni', reads as 'about me'.
'el match kan kheir gdn' unnatural; Egyptians say 'kan 7elw gedan'.
'el kebab kan 3adel tamam' is an odd, non-Egyptian collocation.
'ashrab ahwa 2awi' (drink coffee very) is ungrammatical; needs '2ahwa 2aweya'.
'hanenazem anwa3 akel' is a calque; Egyptians wouldn't organize 'types of food'.
'kan feeh anwa3 ta3ab' is a calque, unnatural Egyptian.
'da men anwa3 el zawat 2ally mamken yet7asal' is garbled.
'nseet arady el mazra3a fel maw3id' is nonsensical.
'arady el mal3ab' calques 'grounds'; Egyptians say 'el nogela' or 'ard el mal3ab'.
'7or 6', '2abal beetna', 'azra2' (blue for azra3) are garbled.
'ana kont rady mestany' is an awkward, unnatural collocation in an apology.
'bel asra3' is MSA-ish; Egyptians say 'besor3a' or 'bsor3a'.
'dakhel el gool el fat7' is garbled.
'lazem akoun asra3' after forgetting an appointment is a calque, non-sequitur.
'asass el ta3m' is a calque; Egyptians say 'el sirr kan fel samna'.
'asass' used for 'asasan'; 'el youm deh' gender error (el yom da).
'el zahma el naharda asasya' is nonsensical.
'kanet asasya lema3na el koshari' is garbled.
'el match kan asasya' wrong gender and wrong meaning; unnatural.
'wel mowasala asasy 3alaya' is awkward, not Egyptian phrasing.
'el match kan asasy, kol la3eb tal3 b talabo kamal' is garbled.
'kont fakr en mitsla7sh aslan, el donya ra7et feen' is garbled.
'2asasa be kam dah akher feha' is garbled.
'w 2asasa khod yemeen' misplaced adverb; 'el gazara' should be 'el gazzar'.
'ezay el ash3a hat2asar 3ala el 3aila' is contextless, unnatural phrasing.
'el tabib' is MSA (doktor); 'el mostashfa bta3ak' unnatural.
'ba3d el estefta7' unclear; 'be sohola' stiff for chat directions.

Gender error: 'el bata2a el asly' should be 'el asleya'.
